claim_decisions.statement: The Bank's April 2024 feature reports 53 community projects completed and 17 youth centres refurbished, alongside youth training/livelihood support. Female beneficiaries' participation in planning, decisions or monitoring reportedly rose from 0% to 56%.
claim_decisions.uncertainty: The 56% denominator is female beneficiaries, not all women or all project participants. Implementation outputs, not evaluated climate or FCV effects.

pathways.climate_pressure: Variable water availability and drought-related pressure discussed in the 2022 regional article.
pathways.documented_impact: Disputed cross-border irrigation infrastructure lacks maintenance and reliable allocation.
pathways.fcv_mediator: Unresolved jurisdiction, cross-border distrust and backlash against repairs constrain infrastructure governance.
pathways.possible_consequence: Water-management capacity can remain weak under climate variability; no effect on a named adaptation project is estimated.
alternative_explanations: Infrastructure degradation, water losses, agricultural demand and contested jurisdiction are important independently of climate trends.
pathways.uncertainty: Source-stated institutional mechanism, not isolated climate causation or an audit of current 2026 border conditions.
resilience_factors: Regional dialogue and strengthened local water governance are proposed responses, not proven impacts.
pathways.compact_statement: Sughd–Batken disputes and repair backlash constrain irrigation governance under variable water availability.
